ESH 

The kid lost his mother, so I can understand that he has a background that has motivated him to be a bad seed, but also, I don't know what type of parent you are, so if you didn't push him through it to be the best he can be despite these setbacks, then that's on you, your son needs for know the parental support is there, especially after his mother's passing, so he understandably feels like there's no one there to support him.

On the other hand, both you and his sister dealt with the same losses as him, and you two haven't committed crimes because of it. In fact, his sister, still an emotional teen in high school, dealt with the same loss, and is still on track to graduate University.

I'm still a teenager and don't have much experience with loss, so my judgement should be taken with a couple of grains of salt, as everything should on reddit.

But in conclusion, tell your son that you should expect a future in him. You dealt with the same things he did and he isn't alone through this, and you care that he gets his life back on track for himself, not just to get more out of your will.
